defs.def: if sth bounces or you bounce it, it moves quickly away from a surface it has just hit or you make it do this （使）弹起，弹跳

ex.s: No matter how many times he failed, he was always able to bounce back pretty quickly.
ex.t: 无论失败多少次，他总能相当快地重新振作起来。

ex.s: Only I soon found out why my weapon had not entered its skin, but bounced off." "Why, Ned, why?" "Because that creature is made of steel." I moved myself quickly to the top of the being, and kicked it.
ex.t: 只是我很快便发现，我的武器为何没能刺进它的皮，而是被弹开了。“为什么，内德，为什么？”“因为那家伙是钢做的。”我迅速挪到那生物顶端，踢了它一脚。

defs.def: to jump up and down on sth 人
to move a child up and down while he or she is sitting on your knee in order to entertain him or her 把小孩放在膝上颠着玩

ex.s: We passed it, he tried to put it in his mouth, he tried bouncing it, rolling it, sitting on it, throwing it.
ex.t: 我们路过它时，他试图把它放进嘴里，又试着弹它、滚它、坐在上面、扔它。

defs.def: to move up and down; to move sth up and down （使）上下晃动

ex.s: Then I saw a group of people in bathing suits bouncing up and down in the water.
ex.t: 然后我看见一群穿着泳衣的人在水里上下蹦跳。

ex.s: As the water boiled, the steam made the top of thekettle bounce up and down.
ex.t: 水烧开时，蒸汽使壶盖上下跳动。

defs.def: to move up and down in a particular direction （朝某个方向）颠簸行进

ex.s: The bumps and rocks that lined the road under the basket caused the ball to bounce in all directions.
ex.t: 沿路排列在篮筐下的颠簸和岩石使球向各个方向弹跳。

defs.def: to move somewhere in a lively and cheerful way 人

ex.s: Hearing the doorbell ring, the boy bounced across the room to open the door.
ex.t: 听到门铃响，男孩蹦跳着穿过房间去开门。

defs.def: if a cheque bounces, or a bank bounces it, the bank refuses to accept it because there is not enough money in the account 拒付，退回（支票等）
to tell sb your ideas in order to find out what they think about them （向某人）透露主意（以试探其反应）
if an email bounces or the system bounces it, it returns to the person who sent it because the system cannot deliver it （电子邮件）弹回；退回（电子邮件）
to force sb to leave a job, team, place, etc. 解雇；开除；撵走；逐出
the action of bouncing 弹跳；跳动
the ability to bounce or to make sth bounce 弹性；反弹力
the energy that a person has 活力；精力

ex.s: I was running so fast that I bounced off the trunk and  40   on my backside.
ex.t: 我跑得太快，结果撞到树干弹了回来，___40___摔在了屁股上。

defs.def: the quality in a person's hair that shows that it is in good condition and means that it does not lie flat 富有弹性；蓬松

chunks.cn: 总是 能够 去 弹起
浴缸 西服 弹起
弹起 在…里 所有 方向
